the inferior aspect of the fissure.", "Determine if the opacity is absent from its usual location within the fissure.", "Assess for signs of mediastinal shift or lung re-expansion that could displace separates the opacity from the heart) or obscured (opacity merges with/blends into the heart contour).", "Apply the silhouette sign: A preserved border indicates the lesion is not in direct contact
